scope.applicability: A Model Instance Binding is a lifecycle-bearing canonical contract separating one exact parent model revision and its authority from one exact local instance revision and its authority while declaring inherited contracts, extension scope, overrides, conformance, adoption, owner, succession, and challenge handling.
exclusions: It is neither the parent model nor the local instance and transfers no parent ownership or unrestricted authority.
Conformance, inheritance, adoption, realization, and identity remain separate claims.
This Definition does not admit a carrier, instance, relation, runtime, consumer, publication, or deployment.
